## Report from Nadia the Rambling Researcher (researcher)

| Registry | Who renders | Format | Regenerated on update? |
|---|---|---|---|
| VS Code Marketplace | Author (README screenshots) | PNG/GIF in README | Only if the author updates them — [publishing-extension](https://code.visualstudio.com/api/working-with-extensions/publishing-extension) |
| Obsidian community themes | Author (`screenshot.png` in repo) | PNG, fixed size | Author's job; reviewers check on submission — [obsidian-releases README](https://github.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-releases) |
| Warp themes | CI (repo action renders from YAML) | PNG per theme | Yes, on every merge — [warp-themes README](https://github.com/warpdotdev/themes) |

**Takeaway:** only Warp does what this repo does (CI-rendered, regenerated on change). The other two put it on the author and accept stale previews.
